svg.title: Group 1: PM itself
svg.desc: The subgroups and tasks of the group PM itself, with status, size, hard dependencies and placements by choice.
svg.text: Formalize the text, volume by volume and chapter by chapter, and check PM's claims about its own
system as each chapter is reached.
S, M, L: weeks, months, longer
needs: the tasks whose results this one requires (its gates). Later by choice: placed after other work by the
maintainer's priorities, not because it must wait.
PM's claims about its own system
